title: Notification regarding the 3rd Saturday i.e.,19-12-2026 shall not be working day.
text:
KEY LINES:
month of December 2026, the third Saturday i.e., 19.12.2026 shall not be a working day as

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 25th November, 2026
/
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ In supersession of earlier order(s), if any in this
regard, it is informed to all learned members of the Bar and litigants that only for the ensuing
month of December 2026, the third Saturday i.e., 19.12.2026 shall not be a working day as
requested by the Bar.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH a#dJ d/
